disclosure: a true a=-3 fixture needs a prime-order group on a curve with a=-3, i.e. point counting (Schoof) at 2^40; that is NOT done here. What is measured is the exact code difference a introduces - the doubling numerator is substituted with 3x^2-3 and the census rerun - plus the incidence of the branch it lives in. The group order therefore differs from the a=0 fixture and that residual is disclosed, not measured.

measured_a_channel.a_channel_bound: |P(a=-3) - P(a=0)| <= (fraction of walker-steps whose transition is a doubling) since only those transitions differ; measured fraction above

structural_fact: for y^2=x^3+ax+b the addition law with x1 != x2 is a-independent; a enters ONLY the doubling numerator, 3x^2+a. The fixture curve has a=0 (numerator 3x^2); production P-256 has a=-3 (numerator 3x^2-3).
verdict_item: census uses an a=0 fixture; production is a=-3
